headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 7, 2026**
article:
The Kansas City Royals dominated the Philadelphia Phillies 15-1, led by Tyler Tolbert's 5 hits, including a home run. Noah Cameron earned the win with 5 strong innings. In other action, the New York Yankees secured a 5-1 victory over the Tampa Bay Rays, with Cam Schlittler pitching 8.0 innings and José Caballero hitting 2 home runs. The Washington Nationals overcame a 5-run deficit to defeat the Houston Astros 11-12, with CJ Abrams leading the offense.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries, including Byron Buxton, who has been placed on the 10-day injured list by the Minnesota Twins due to a right hip strain. Other injured players include Konnor Griffin (Pittsburgh Pirates), David Hamilton (Milwaukee Brewers), Brandon Lockridge (Milwaukee Brewers), Max Rajcic (St. Louis Cardinals), Martín Pérez (Atlanta Braves), and Brandon Woodruff (Milwaukee Brewers).

The New York Mets acquired RHP Matt Seelinger from the Detroit Tigers in a trade for cash. The Detroit Tigers also traded RHP Woo-Suk Go to the Minnesota Twins for cash. The Philadelphia Phillies traded RHP Ryan Degges to the Cleveland Guardians for cash, while the Houston Astros traded LHP Tom Cosgrove to the Washington Nationals for cash.

top_news.title: **Royals Rout Phillies 15-1**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals dominated the Philadelphia Phillies in a one-sided game, winning 15-1. Tyler Tolbert led the Royals' offense with 5 hits, including a home run, while Noah Cameron earned the win with 5 strong innings.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Rays 5-1**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a 5-1 victory over the Tampa Bay Rays, led by a dominant performance from Cam Schlittler, who pitched 8.0 innings with 8 strikeouts and 1 earned run. José Caballero had a standout game at the plate, hitting 2 home runs and driving in 4 runs.

top_news.title: **Nationals Come from Behind to Win 11-12**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals overcame a 5-run deficit to defeat the Houston Astros 11-12 in a thrilling matchup. CJ Abrams led the Nationals' offense with 3 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Mets Edge Braves in Thrilling 7-6 Victory**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets secured a hard-fought win against the Atlanta Braves, outlasting their opponents 7-6. Matt Olson led the Braves' offense with a strong performance, recording 2 hits and 2 home runs.

top_news.title: **Brewers Edge Cardinals in Thrilling 4-3 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers secured a narrow win over the St. Louis Cardinals, with Christian Yelich and Jake Bauers contributing key hits in the game. Jacob Misiorowski stood out on the mound for the Brewers, helping to secure the 4-3 final score.

top_news.title: **Buxton Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Minnesota Twins center fielder Byron Buxton has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right hip strain, effective retroactive to July 6, 2026.

top_news.title: **Mets Acquire RHP Matt Seelinger in Trade**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets have acquired right-handed pitcher Matt Seelinger in a trade with the Detroit Tigers, who received cash in return.
